title: Elixir v1.20: Now a gradually typed language
summary: Elixir v1.20 officially introduces gradual typing, transforming Elixir from a purely dynamic language into a gradually typed language where developers can optionally add type specifications that are enforced at compile-time or runtime depending on the context.
problem_solved: Addresses the tension between dynamic flexibility and static type safety by allowing incremental type adoption without requiring full codebase rewrites.
why_valuable: Enables development teams to catch type-related bugs earlier through optional compile-time checks while maintaining Elixir's dynamic nature for rapid prototyping and experimentation.
